rev6.release_notes: Updates: if CAD CAM is still open when G-SEND.IO closes, you are asked to close it, and CAD CAM's update installs. Before, it waited without a word.

cadcam.release_notes: Recognize Part: the part is lit by feature kind, found by a scan sweep front to back; the list sits beside the part, hover lights a feature, a click isolates it, labels follow the view, SECTION cuts through the turning axis. Right-click a body > Recognize Part..., or CAM > Turning > RECOGNIZE. Healed / sewn edges read their true size (2.0001 now 2.0). Drawings: sections, details and broken-out views, and every sheet of a print or export, are made in the background so the window no longer freezes; a drawing shows a quick blue PREVIEW first while the exact lines are made.
